# Common English words used by tests/test_lexicon_skills.py as false-match bait.
# One lowercase word per line. Compiled by hand for Hiring Panel (fictional test data, MIT).
#
# Every word here is ordinary English. A lexicon entry that is neither `ambiguous` nor
# `case_sensitive` must not match any of these words, or a resume that says "go above and
# beyond" would be credited with the Go language.
#
# Deliberately left out: words that ARE field or skill names when they appear on a resume or
# in a job posting (marketing, accounting, finance, leadership, retail, research ...). Matching
# those is the intended behaviour, not a false match.
#
# The final block of the source list was everyday words that double as product names
# (slack, zoom, excel, word, spark ...), which is exactly the bait we want.
